reviewAmendments.scope: Only the browser qualification TSV parser and cfg(conformance)-only regex probe; production schema source is unchanged.
closure: All three immutable native TSV corpora are parsed as exactly seven fields: minor, case ID, operation, status, span, text codepoints, pattern codepoints. Tab splitting preserves empty codepoint fields.
Rows bind exactly to frozen fixture operation/pattern/text; only Python minors 11/12/13 are accepted. Unique minor/case identity and exact expected corpus sizes establish complete profile coverage.

M requires a search operation and an exact canonical nonnegative safe-integer start/end span within codepoint text bounds. E/N require the literal no-span marker -. Unknown statuses, arbitrary spans, malformed rows and duplicates fail.
The browser compares actual probe strings exactly for every row, including every match span. No normalization of arbitrary actual errors or spans was introduced.

The cfg(conformance)-only Rust probe emits E only for PYTHON_REGEX_SYNTAX; other compile errors and all unexpected search/profile/operation failures produce X, which cannot satisfy a frozen E/N/M expectation.
